dossier.claim: Some renderings retain the broad event while dropping a specified relation, instruction, object, or constraint. The missing material matters at the level claimed, even when the next action remains understandable.
dossier.sourcePattern: The selected source specifies conscious attraction, a cushion as the seat, an injunction to keep running, the named route-title rationale, dozens of offensive and defensive exchanges, and an ideal that must not be betrayed.
dossier.englishEffect: Saber’s gendered effect becomes a claim that she is real. The cushion and church symbol disappear, an instruction is reduced to a destination, and the route-title explanation is shortened to the game name. Other lines lose the defensive side of swordplay or replace the stated arm-pulling movement with pulling oneself up.
dossier.limits: Concision and implicit information are not automatically omissions of meaning. Attraction can be conveyed without literally saying opposite sex, and adjoining sentences can preserve a consequence. The cushion case is a local loss of staging detail, not a claim that the scene becomes incomprehensible. The counterexamples retain qualified possibilities, memories, and concrete landscape detail.
dossier.diagnostic: 770 findings in this category; 8 cited passages.

contexts.english: It probably is mostly pride, like he said.

contexts.japanese: 十年間、弟子だった生け贄を見下ろしている。

findings.explanation: Five scene-specific Japanese chant variants are replaced by unrelated stock English Unlimited Blade Works lines.

findings.description: Shirou's promise to inherit his old man's dream becomes a vague question about that dream.

findings.explanation: Shirou's promise to inherit his old man's dream becomes a vague question about that dream.

contexts.english: Your dream, huh?

findings.description: Archer parrying one incoming stroke becomes merely wielding his sword skillfully.

contexts.english: He wields his longsword with swift skill.

findings.description: One arm and one leg breaking becomes one unspecified limb breaking.

contexts.english: The impact breaks one of my limbs.

contexts.english: Saber breathes in deeply and considers her condition.

findings.description: Continuous layered Projection becomes simply releasing all Projections.

findings.explanation: Continuous layered Projection becomes simply releasing all Projections.

findings.explanation: A fatal sword that tears the enemy apart becomes a technique that merely cuts.

contexts.english: its precision and speed are astonishing.

findings.explanation: An asura's art challenging gods and Buddhas in a human body becomes man's attempt to challenge them.

findings.description: The reaching gesture still recalls the earlier rescue, but the gray sky disappears. The loss is a specific visual connection, not the entire connection to the fire.

findings.explanation: The reaching gesture still recalls the earlier rescue, but the gray sky disappears. The loss is a specific visual connection, not the entire connection to the fire.

findings.explanation: Saber's arrival scattering Gilgamesh's projectiles becomes a gust merely intervening.

findings.explanation: The proprietor as an infernal jailer returning from training becomes a spiritual trial for diners.

contexts.english: Maybe the restaurant's name alludes to the spiritual trial it takes to eat here.

findings.description: An unknown method becomes only an unknown scheme.

findings.explanation: An unknown method becomes only an unknown scheme.

contexts.japanese: 私たちが知らない方法でマスターになる

contexts.english: serve Illya the best I can, as her knight.

findings.description: Regretting an insufficiently considered apology becomes regretting not apologizing.

findings.explanation: Regretting an insufficiently considered apology becomes regretting not apologizing.

contexts.english: I should've apologized to Illya, no doubt about it.

findings.explanation: The Shadow’s lack of three-dimensionality disappears.

contexts.english: The Shadow stands there, upright and ethereal.

findings.explanation: Archer’s inability to reach Rin in time is omitted.

contexts.english: Archer starts running,

findings.description: Eating despite difficulty becomes eating enough to feel full.

findings.description: Shirou’s sense that this is the last question becomes merely sounding like a question.

contexts.english: It's nearly impossible for a human who isn't a mage to handle a Servant.

findings.explanation: The shock at generations of inherited work being consumed in mere hours loses the hours.

contexts.japanese: なんでたった数時間でなくなる
contexts.english: How can you just lose something that's been built up over generations!?

findings.description: Responsibility for the justice-hero oath becomes merely having sworn to do right.

findings.explanation: Responsibility for the justice-hero oath becomes merely having sworn to do right.

contexts.english: I've sworn to do the right thing.

findings.explanation: The expected benefit of fever medicine becomes waiting for the fever to break. His plans for a caretaker and a later hospital visit remain.

contexts.english: now I just need to wait for her fever to break.

findings.description: The Matou house being larger loses the size comparison.

contexts.english: It'll save the people that she would have killed.

findings.explanation: Threatening the restraining arm at its root becomes blasting Shirou generally.

contexts.japanese: 根元から吹っ飛ばされて
contexts.english: I'll blast you so hard you go flying outside.

findings.description: The paired fear of lying and ending the lie becomes only fear of stopping it.

findings.explanation: The paired fear of lying and ending the lie becomes only fear of stopping it.

contexts.english: I was too afraid to stop lying to you

contexts.english: I'll keep forgiving Sakura, even if no one else does.

contexts.japanese: 先輩が好きでも、先輩のためになれない
contexts.english: It won't be good for you.

findings.explanation: Squeezing hard enough to draw blood loses the bleeding.

contexts.japanese: 血が滲むほど俺を握りしめる
contexts.english: Sakura squeezes me hard.

findings.explanation: Ordinary existence itself now consuming energy disappears into a generic heavy burden.

contexts.japanese: 今はそれだけで魔力を消費するものになっている
contexts.english: it hammers home how heavy the burden is.

findings.description: An unknown thing biting into him becomes an unspecified change into something unknown.

findings.explanation: An unknown thing biting into him becomes an unspecified change into something unknown.

contexts.japanese: よく分からない何かに食いつかれ
contexts.english: it became something I don't quite understand.

findings.description: Medicine is reduced to swallowing something.

findings.explanation: Medicine is reduced to swallowing something.

contexts.japanese: ちょっと薬を飲んでもらうだけ
contexts.english: have you swallow something.

findings.description: Sakura’s subordinate school relationship becomes general respect.

findings.explanation: Sakura’s subordinate school relationship becomes general respect.

contexts.japanese: 自分はただの後輩だから訊けなかった
contexts.english: she didn't ask out of respect for you!

findings.explanation: The Japanese explains that intimidating pressure scales with sensed magical energy. The English instead says magical energy causes skin-crawling, losing the relation behind Shirou's comparison of Rider's strength.

contexts.english: The raw magical energy that Servants give off is enough to make my skin crawl.

contexts.english: the other is raised to live a normal life.

findings.explanation: Whether all Masters must be killed becomes whether they must kill each other.

findings.explanation: Every impending trial being a dead end becomes merely plenty of dead ends.

findings.explanation: Protecting Sakura without her finding out loses the secrecy requirement.

contexts.english: can you think of a way to protect her!?

contexts.japanese: なんとか知られないまま守れる方法
contexts.english: can you think of a way to protect her!?

findings.explanation: Eating with the boys and arguing on the return becomes a solitary account of eating and grumbling.

contexts.english: I grumble about it as I go back to my classroom.

findings.description: Anger fading on seeing his face becomes merely no longer being angry.

findings.explanation: Anger fading on seeing his face becomes merely no longer being angry.

findings.explanation: The maximum energy usable at once becomes a general limit on what accumulated energy can do.

findings.explanation: The English changes extra energy into Taiga's usual cheerfulness. Her unusually early arrival remains, but Shirou's observation that she is livelier than normal is lost.

contexts.english: she's as chipper as ever.

findings.explanation: Shirou appealing to what anyone would normally do becomes only his own prior plan.

findings.explanation: A peak energy-use ceiling becomes a generic limit on what stored energy can do.

contexts.japanese: 一度に使える魔力の最大量
contexts.english: there's only so much they can do with it

contexts.english: I'll have to convince Fuji-nee.

contexts.english: if I give her a handicap and play without rooks.

findings.explanation: Risk of becoming a target becomes generic counterproductivity.

contexts.english: could prove counterproductive.

findings.explanation: Pride possible even on her own becomes simply more pride in herself.

contexts.japanese: 自分ひとりでも胸を張れる
contexts.english: more pride in herself.

contexts.japanese: 自分ひとりでも胸を張れる
contexts.english: more pride in herself.

findings.description: The room dominated by rustling insect sound becomes a room physically overrun with bugs.
findings.sourceReading: ガサガサと壁を這う虫の音 pairs a specific audible wall-crawling texture with rotten smell.
findings.explanation: The room dominated by rustling insect sound becomes a room physically overrun with bugs.

contexts.japanese: ガサガサと壁を這う虫の音
contexts.english: completely overrun by the bugs teeming over the walls

findings.description: Tens of thousands of insects become an unquantified swarm.
findings.sourceReading: 何万 is the scale of room-filling insects that one stick cannot sweep away.
findings.explanation: Tens of thousands of insects become an unquantified swarm.

contexts.japanese: 何万という虫
contexts.english: the swarms of insects

findings.description: Choose a way to die becomes merely the choice is yours.
findings.sourceReading: 好きな死に方を選ぶ turns every offered course into a fatal outcome, mocking his actual tactical agency.
findings.explanation: Choose a way to die becomes merely the choice is yours.

contexts.japanese: 好きな死に方を選ぶがよい
contexts.english: The choice is yours.

findings.description: Rapid loss of heat/color becomes pain as if bleeding.
findings.sourceReading: 急速に熱を失っていく with いろ ruby layers fading heat and color after the attempted recall.
findings.explanation: Rapid loss of heat/color becomes pain as if bleeding.

contexts.japanese: 急速に熱を失っていく
contexts.english: It hurts where the Command Spells are, almost like I'm bleeding there.

findings.description: Deferring thanks until breakfast becomes going to have breakfast.
findings.sourceReading: 朝メシの時にしよう carries forward the preceding plan to thank Saber: do it at breakfast because she is probably asleep now.
findings.explanation: Deferring thanks until breakfast becomes going to have breakfast.

contexts.japanese: 朝メシの時にしよう
contexts.english: so I'll go have breakfast.

findings.description: Vaguely overhearing Sakura and Saber becomes remembering participating in their talk.
findings.sourceReading: Sakura and Saber were talking; Shirou thinks he heard them unclearly and asks what happened.
findings.explanation: Vaguely overhearing Sakura and Saber becomes remembering participating in their talk.

contexts.japanese: 桜とセイバーがなんか話してた気がする。……よく聞こえなかったんだけど、そん時なにかあったのか？
contexts.english: I remember talking with you and Saber about something.

findings.description: Saber's reference to an entity classifiable as neither Master nor Servant becomes a question about ignoring other participants. The previous page preserves the classification uncertainty, so the loss is local to her stated objection.
findings.sourceReading: Saber questions engaging something that cannot be identified as either Master or Servant and appears unrelated to their objective.
findings.explanation: Saber's reference to an entity classifiable as neither Master nor Servant becomes a question about ignoring other participants. The previous page preserves the classification uncertainty, so the loss is local to her stated objection.

contexts.japanese: マスターともサーヴァントとも取れぬ
contexts.english: ignore the other Masters and Servants?

findings.description: An outside enemy corrupting the Grail War becomes merely her enemies in it.
findings.sourceReading: 聖杯戦争を汚す外敵 explains her stated purpose as removal of an external contaminating force.
findings.explanation: An outside enemy corrupting the Grail War becomes merely her enemies in it.

contexts.japanese: 聖杯戦争を汚す外敵を排除しに
contexts.english: to eliminate her enemies in the Holy Grail War.

findings.description: The pain of an engraved Magic Crest becomes simply the Crest engraved in her arm.
findings.sourceReading: 刻まれた魔術刻印の痛み is one of Rin’s specific remembered hardships.
findings.explanation: The pain of an engraved Magic Crest becomes simply the Crest engraved in her arm.

contexts.japanese: 刻まれた魔術刻印の痛み
contexts.english: the Magic Crest engraved in her arm.

findings.description: Rin's explanation loses the excessive self-love that she says produces Shinji's contempt. The contrast with her preceding description of self-hatred is consequently less explicit.
findings.sourceReading: Rin says excessive love of himself led Shinji to look down on others, whose superiority then trapped him in inferiority. This follows her description of a disposition involving self-hatred.
findings.explanation: Rin's explanation loses the excessive self-love that she says produces Shinji's contempt. The contrast with her preceding description of self-hatred is consequently less explicit.

contexts.japanese: 自分が好きなあまり周りを下に見たものの
contexts.english: You scorn everything around you

findings.description: Two possible reasons for watching Sakura collapse into unconscious watching.
findings.sourceReading: The narrator wonders whether he has nothing else to do or his eyes follow her unconsciously.
findings.explanation: Two possible reasons for watching Sakura collapse into unconscious watching.

contexts.japanese: 他にやる事がなかったからか、それとも、無意識に目が追ってしまうのか
contexts.english: I unconsciously find myself watching her.

findings.description: Saber's condition—face Assassin alone or expose the Master to the first attack—becomes a statement of Assassin's preference. Her protective purpose remains clear from the door and surrounding warnings.
findings.sourceReading: Saber says that unless she faces Assassin one-on-one, the Master will be attacked first.
findings.explanation: Saber's condition—face Assassin alone or expose the Master to the first attack—becomes a statement of Assassin's preference. Her protective purpose remains clear from the door and surrounding warnings.

contexts.japanese: 一騎打ちで望まなければ、先にマスターを叩かれてしまう
contexts.english: Assassin prefers to kill Masters first, rather than duel other Servants!

findings.description: A stick about the size of a wooden sword loses its size comparison.
findings.sourceReading: 木刀ほどの警策 gives the physical scale of the weapon he immediately Strengthens.
findings.explanation: A stick about the size of a wooden sword loses its size comparison.

contexts.japanese: 木刀ほどの警策
contexts.english: a kyousaku stick that's handy enough to be a weapon

findings.description: The previously folded-back forearm with its palm sewn at the shoulder loses the folded arrangement.
findings.sourceReading: 肘から折り畳まれ、その掌を肩に置いた状態 explains why the elbow looked like the arm’s end and the hand was invisible.
findings.explanation: The previously folded-back forearm with its palm sewn at the shoulder loses the folded arrangement.

contexts.japanese: 肘から折り畳まれ、その掌を肩に置いた状態で縫い付けられていた腕
contexts.english: It bends into a grotesque forearm and hand that seems sewn into his shoulder.

findings.description: The necessity to carry duty through becomes merely still having something to do.
findings.sourceReading: やるべき事を、やり通さなければ insists on finishing what he must do despite loss of his means.
findings.explanation: The necessity to carry duty through becomes merely still having something to do.

contexts.japanese: やるべき事を、やり通さなければ
contexts.english: But I still have something to do.

findings.description: The last long touch loses its sustained duration.
findings.sourceReading: 最後に長く modifies the final movement of his finger over the blood before its release without bow or thanks.
findings.explanation: The last long touch loses its sustained duration.

contexts.japanese: 最後に長く、血の跡に指を這わせた
contexts.english: I touch the blood stain one last time.

findings.explanation: The English omits the final surge of pain before the marks disappear. It preserves their disappearance and the following explanation that Shirou has lost his qualification as a Master.

contexts.japanese: 一際強く左手が痛み、消えた
contexts.english: The pain in my left hand is gone.

findings.description: Wiping the wound before gauze is omitted.
findings.sourceReading: 傷口を拭いて precedes the requested dressing after he asks for no more antiseptic.
findings.explanation: Wiping the wound before gauze is omitted.

contexts.japanese: 傷口を拭いてガーゼでも貼っといてくれ
contexts.english: just dress the wounds with gauze.

findings.description: Persistent questioning with a pout becomes simply pouting until confession.
findings.sourceReading: 拗ね顔で問い詰められた結果 makes questioning the means by which he is made to confess the injury.
findings.explanation: Persistent questioning with a pout becomes simply pouting until confession.

contexts.japanese: 拗ね顔で問い詰められた結果
contexts.english: she pouted until I confessed that I got injured

findings.description: More absence from tomorrow loses the increase.
findings.sourceReading: もっと家を留守にする forecasts greater absence while explicitly allowing Sakura to keep using the house.
findings.explanation: More absence from tomorrow loses the increase.

contexts.japanese: 明日からもっと家を留守にするだろう
contexts.english: I'm probably going to be out of the house from tomorrow

findings.description: English restates Shirou's resolve but omits his reminder that he had already declared this commitment.
findings.sourceReading: Shirou invokes his earlier declaration that he would become a hero of justice.
findings.explanation: English restates Shirou's resolve but omits his reminder that he had already declared this commitment.

contexts.japanese: 正義の味方になるって言ったんだ
contexts.english: I'm going to be a man who does what's right.

findings.description: Wanting pleasure even at the expense of protection becomes wanting to waste his protection.
findings.sourceReading: それを無駄にしてもよろこびを得たい makes pleasure the goal, even if his protective efforts are made futile.
findings.explanation: Wanting pleasure even at the expense of protection becomes wanting to waste his protection.

contexts.japanese: それを無駄にしてもよろこびを得たい
contexts.english: wanting to waste his efforts to protect her.

findings.description: Seeking the same thing from the Grail becomes seeking the same Grail.

findings.explanation: Seeking the same thing from the Grail becomes seeking the same Grail.

contexts.japanese: 聖杯に求めるものは同じ
contexts.english: we seek the same grail.

findings.description: Former Disciple Number One is addressed as a current Disciple Number One.
findings.sourceReading: もと弟子一号 marks the graduated pupil whose readmission is being refused.
findings.explanation: Former Disciple Number One is addressed as a current Disciple Number One.

contexts.japanese: もと弟子一号
contexts.english: Disciple Number One!?

findings.description: The demand to recover by dinner loses the deadline.
findings.sourceReading: それまでに体を治して refers to the dinner she will bring; the next narrator calls this an impossible demand.
findings.explanation: The demand to recover by dinner loses the deadline.

contexts.japanese: それまでに体を治しておくこと
contexts.english: you need to let yourself rest and recover.

findings.description: Sakura's stated wish to nurse Shirou becomes a general wish to thank him. The surrounding scene still makes her caregiving role clear.
findings.sourceReading: Sakura clarifies that she wants to skip school because she wants to nurse Shirou, describing it hesitantly as thanks for yesterday.
findings.explanation: Sakura's stated wish to nurse Shirou becomes a general wish to thank him. The surrounding scene still makes her caregiving role clear.

contexts.japanese: 先輩の看病がしたいので
contexts.english: I'm going to play hooky t-to thank you for yesterday!

findings.explanation: Trying to hold him with one hand while holding the thermometer in the other becomes a threatening thermometer approaching.

contexts.japanese: 片手に体温計を持って、片手でこっちの体を押さえにかかる
contexts.english: The thermometer inches threateningly towards me, its holder losing her composure.

findings.description: Going out behind their backs becomes a general question about sanity.
findings.sourceReading: 私たちの目を盗んで出かける explicitly names evading their observation to leave while ill.
findings.explanation: Going out behind their backs becomes a general question about sanity.

contexts.japanese: 私たちの目を盗んで出かけるとは
contexts.english: Have you taken leave of your senses!?

findings.description: The food trio’s mock sacred-treasures elevation becomes a plain fame claim.

findings.explanation: The food trio’s mock sacred-treasures elevation becomes a plain fame claim.

contexts.japanese: 三種の神器を扱うお店だ
contexts.english: They're famed for their taiyaki buns, dorayaki pancakes, and takoyaki octopus bites.

findings.description: Splitting leftovers or giving them to someone with room becomes a single halves-for-anyone plan.
findings.sourceReading: 半分にして分けるか、余裕のあるヤツに食べてもらう offers two alternatives for the remainder.
findings.explanation: Splitting leftovers or giving them to someone with room becomes a single halves-for-anyone plan.

contexts.japanese: 残ったのは半分にして分けるか、余裕のあるヤツに食べてもらう
contexts.english: split the rest into halves that anyone can help themselves too.

findings.sourceReading: 私たちとは違うお方 gives Sella’s asserted distinction between Illya and themselves as her reason for proper address.
findings.explanation: Illya being different from the maids becomes simply their serving her.

contexts.japanese: イリヤスフィール様は私たちとは違うお方です
contexts.english: We serve Lady Illyasviel.

findings.description: Her asking quietly becomes the girl being physically small.
findings.sourceReading: 小さく modifies 問い掛けてきた, naming the subdued manner or voice after expected rejection.
findings.explanation: Her asking quietly becomes the girl being physically small.

contexts.japanese: 小さく、白い少女は問い掛けてきた
contexts.english: The small, white-haired girl asks me.

findings.explanation: His refusal to be defeated easily disappears and the dialogue is left unclosed.

contexts.japanese: そう簡単にやられる訳には—
contexts.english: but I'm a Master, too.

findings.explanation: Illya being a girl as an additional reason to soften becomes simply her being a kid.

findings.explanation: Being sent out as the highest Master loses that assigned excellence.

contexts.japanese: 最高のマスターとして送り出された
contexts.english: who they sent to carry out their thousand-year-old obsession.

findings.explanation: Repeating the projectile attack being fatal to the attacker becomes his life being available to take.

contexts.japanese: 何よりおまえにとっちゃ命取りだ
contexts.english: it's yours that's ripe for the taking.

findings.explanation: The explanation that distance gives him no safe zone is omitted.

contexts.japanese: 今の貴方の実力では間合いの外も内もない
contexts.english: You must not let your guard down just because you've retreated out of your opponent's reach.

findings.description: The English keeps the imagined errand but drops Shirou's alternative guess that Taiga wants to share a spontaneous comic story.

findings.explanation: The English keeps the imagined errand but drops Shirou's alternative guess that Taiga wants to share a spontaneous comic story.

contexts.japanese: 唐突に思いついた小噺を聞かせようとか
contexts.english: expecting her to ask me to bring her something she left at home.

findings.explanation: That is precisely why disappears from her answer to his anger denial.

contexts.japanese: ……だから、です。先輩、自分で気付いてない
contexts.english: You didn't notice, then.

findings.explanation: Only preparing Strengthened weapons ahead of time becomes only Strengthening something into a weapon.

contexts.japanese: 武器を用意しておく事しかできない
contexts.english: All I can do is Strengthen something into a weapon.

findings.explanation: The offer loses its specific reason: Sakura may be wide awake after resting so much. Shirou still offers her companionship.

contexts.japanese: 寝てばっかりで目が冴えてるんなら
contexts.english: If you want someone to talk to before you go back to bed

findings.description: Helping the weak and defeating the strong becomes being strong and helping the weak.

findings.explanation: Helping the weak and defeating the strong becomes being strong and helping the weak.

contexts.japanese: 弱きを助け強きをくじく
contexts.english: someone strong who helps the weak.

findings.explanation: His present relief that Sakura is not pushing herself becomes only a past worry.

contexts.japanese: 桜は無茶をしていないようだ
contexts.english: I was worried that Sakura might be pushing herself too hard.

findings.description: Anticipated reproach for daytime intimacy becomes a new future living-room encounter.
findings.sourceReading: He fears next-door witnesses despising what they are doing in broad daylight.
findings.explanation: Anticipated reproach for daytime intimacy becomes a new future living-room encounter.

contexts.japanese: 昼間っから何してるんだって軽蔑される
contexts.english: the next time we're in the living room.

findings.description: The sisters’ mutual watching becomes Sakura alone watching Rin.
findings.sourceReading: わたしたちはお互い establishes reciprocal attention at a distance.
findings.explanation: The sisters’ mutual watching becomes Sakura alone watching Rin.

contexts.japanese: わたしたちはお互いを遠くからよく見てた
contexts.english: I fixated on it, and often watched her from afar.

findings.explanation: Inability to solve the root problem and a plan to consult Rider become no help and Rider’s possible ideas.

findings.explanation: Mirror polishing retains erosion but loses clouding.

contexts.english: polished to a mirror-like shine while it erodes away.

findings.description: Grasping the arm’s cloth becomes grasping the arm.
findings.sourceReading: His right hand grips the wrapping on the left arm, relevant to Illya’s warning against removing it.
findings.explanation: Grasping the arm’s cloth becomes grasping the arm.

contexts.japanese: 右手が左腕の布を掴んでいる
contexts.english: my right hand is grabbing my left arm.

findings.description: That is why I warned you becomes anyway, it is dangerous.
findings.sourceReading: He reuses his earlier dangerous warning as a strained excuse after hitting his head.
findings.explanation: That is why I warned you becomes anyway, it is dangerous.

contexts.japanese: だから、危ないって、言ったんだ
contexts.english: Anyway, it's dangerous.

findings.description: Recalling a proper activation incantation becomes instantly recalling his incantations.
findings.sourceReading: キチンとした qualifies the activation spell; deliberate intent allows remembering it, with no speed specification.
findings.explanation: Recalling a proper activation incantation becomes instantly recalling his incantations.

contexts.japanese: キチンとした起動呪文も思い起こせる
contexts.english: you can instantly recall his incantations

findings.description: Timing and determination disappear into doing his best with what he has.

findings.explanation: Timing and determination disappear into doing his best with what he has.

contexts.japanese: これはタイミングと気合の問題
contexts.english: I'm just doing the best I can with what I got.

findings.explanation: Uncertainty about winning the war becomes uncertainty about when it ends.

contexts.japanese: 勝ち残ったところでどうなるか判らない
contexts.english: I don't know what's going to happen once the war is over.

findings.description: The shadow being the greater priority becomes another equal concern.

findings.explanation: The shadow being the greater priority becomes another equal concern.

findings.explanation: A posture instruction becomes a resilience idiom.

contexts.english: Come on, suck it up.

findings.description: Never having been called that becomes generic surprise at hearing it.

findings.explanation: Never having been called that becomes generic surprise at hearing it.

contexts.english: I was just surprised to hear it.

findings.description: Recovered ordinary thought and speech retain only thought.

findings.explanation: Recovered ordinary thought and speech retain only thought.

findings.explanation: Rin’s near-daily archery-club watching becomes Sakura hanging around the club.

findings.explanation: The English omits the gallbladder from the organ list. The surrounding account of extensive internal injury remains.

contexts.english: liver, and all eight sections of my large intestine.

findings.explanation: Paired left-arm distress and right-arm loss become the first being drowned out.

contexts.english: the discomfort and fear of my left arm is drowned out by the pleasure in my right.
