findings.sourceReading: In this situation exactly one Servant plausibly can join, as hint to required partner.
findings.explanation: Only one available Servant loses uniqueness.

contexts.japanese: この状況において、一人だけ仲間になってくれそうなサーヴァントがいる筈である！
contexts.english: There should be a Servant willing to help you out!

findings.description: Sakura's denial of becoming the one authentic Hassan becomes a denial of being a true Hassan. The loss concerns the skull-masked assassin's desired identity.
findings.sourceReading: Sakura denies that the skull-masked assassin can become the sole authentic Hassan, following her rejection of his wish to recover his name.
findings.explanation: Sakura's denial of becoming the one authentic Hassan becomes a denial of being a true Hassan. The loss concerns the skull-masked assassin's desired identity.

contexts.japanese: 「消えなさい山の主。貴方は何者でもない一人の暗殺者、ただ一人の本物になど成れないわ」
contexts.english: "Disappear, lord of the mountain. You're nobody, just an assassin. You will never be a true Hassan."

findings.description: Speed enabling disengagement becomes speed contrasted with forced retreat.
findings.sourceReading: Only her superhuman speed enables her to disengage despite receiving Saber's counterattacks.
findings.explanation: Speed enabling disengagement becomes speed contrasted with forced retreat.

contexts.japanese: ……超人的なスピードを誇る彼女だからこそ、セイバーの反撃を受けつつ離脱できる。
contexts.english: She boasts superhuman speed, but she's being forced back by Saber's counterattacks.

findings.description: Blood-formed summoning eye loses blood material.
findings.sourceReading: Huge eye in front of Rider is formed with red blood as part of summoning circle.
findings.explanation: Blood-formed summoning eye loses blood material.

contexts.japanese: 彼女の前面に、赤い血で結ばれた巨大な眼が現れる。
contexts.english: A giant red eyeball appears in front of her.

findings.description: Blood-formed eye lost in chain-opening branch too.
findings.sourceReading: This intact occurrence again specifies eye formed with red blood.
findings.explanation: Blood-formed eye lost in chain-opening branch too.

contexts.japanese: 彼女の前面に、赤い血で結ばれた巨大な眼が現れる。
contexts.english: A giant red eyeball appears in front of her.

findings.description: Ninety-percent cancellation line absent from chain-opening English.
findings.sourceReading: Japanese says Saber's holy sword cancels nine tenths of Bellerophon's light.
findings.explanation: Ninety-percent cancellation line absent from chain-opening English.

contexts.japanese: ベルレフォーンの光はその九割を、セイバーの聖剣によって相殺された。

findings.description: Specified nucleus accumbens becomes generic forebrain.
findings.sourceReading: An internal crack is located specifically in 大脳の側座核, with motivation/pleasure gloss following.
findings.explanation: Specified nucleus accumbens becomes generic forebrain.

contexts.japanese: 外ではなく内、大脳の側座核が割れた。
contexts.english: Not outside, but inside my forebrain.

contexts.japanese: 行動原理、即ち快楽の連動を司るところ。
contexts.english: The part that controls my behavior principles and sense of pleasure.

findings.description: Nearly all sensation becomes all five senses.
findings.sourceReading: Most of his senses have turned to iron.
findings.explanation: Nearly all sensation becomes all five senses.

contexts.japanese: 五感は、そのほとんどが鉄になっている。
contexts.english: My five senses have already turned to iron.

findings.description: Nucleus accumbens loses its specified location.
findings.sourceReading: Internal crack specifically affects 大脳の側座核, followed by motivation/pleasure gloss.
findings.explanation: Nucleus accumbens loses its specified location.

contexts.japanese: 外ではなく内、大脳の側座核が割れた。
contexts.english: Not outside, but inside my forebrain.

contexts.japanese: 行動原理、即ち快楽の連動を司るところ。
contexts.english: The part that controls my behavior principles and sense of pleasure.

findings.description: Right-hand biting pain unable to stop memory loss becomes boy unable to stop agony of loss and memories.
findings.sourceReading: Even pain from biting fingers of right hand cannot stop disappearing memory.
findings.explanation: Right-hand biting pain unable to stop memory loss becomes boy unable to stop agony of loss and memories.

contexts.japanese: 右手の指を食べる痛みも、記憶の消失を止められない。
contexts.english: I can't stop the agony of loss and the disappearance of my memories.

contexts.japanese: 自分が自分のままでいる事に、指を食うほど執着している。
contexts.english: I bite my fingers to remind myself that I'm still me.

findings.description: New miracle's application of earlier far-seeing magecraft omitted.
findings.sourceReading: She says the new act is an application of magecraft/far-seeing shown before, though this time impressive.
findings.explanation: New miracle's application of earlier far-seeing magecraft omitted.

contexts.japanese: 前に見せた魔術の応用だけど、今度のはすごいんだよ。
contexts.english: Last time, I showed you how to see far away with magecraft, but this time, it'll be really amazing!

findings.description: Surface Master gate and underground Greater Grail distinction disappears.
findings.sourceReading: Rin explains surface site is a gate for Masters who merely want Grail, while to reach the Greater Grail, source of the war, they must go down rather than up.
findings.explanation: Surface Master gate and underground Greater Grail distinction disappears.

contexts.japanese: 「いえ、柳洞寺に用はないわ。上で作られてる場は表向きの、ただ聖杯を欲しがるマスター用の門よ。……聖杯戦争の大聖杯に行こうっていうんなら、上じゃなくて下に行かないとね」
contexts.english: "No, we're not going to the temple. The compound up top was built just for show, for the benefit of Masters seeking the Holy Grail."

findings.description: Absolute killing intent omitted from first sight of Saber.
findings.sourceReading: Saber waits clothed in absolute killing intent.
findings.explanation: Absolute killing intent omitted from first sight of Saber.

contexts.japanese: 絶対の殺気を纏って、セイバーが待っていた。
contexts.english: stands Saber, waiting for us.

findings.description: Three intruders become both.
findings.sourceReading: Saber could face all three: Rin, Shirou and Rider, alone.
findings.explanation: Three intruders become both.

contexts.japanese: 桜を守る最強のサーヴァントであるセイバーなら、一人きりで俺たち三人の相手が出来る。
contexts.english: She's the strongest Servant protecting Sakura, and she could take us both alone.

contexts.japanese: 「士郎、貴方は後ろに。指示通り、セイバーの相手は私がします」
contexts.english: "Shirou, get behind me. I will engage Saber, as planned."

findings.description: Remaining Shirou and Rider become Shirou alone.
findings.sourceReading: After Rin goes on, boy and Rider remain.
findings.explanation: Remaining Shirou and Rider become Shirou alone.

contexts.japanese: 遠坂が奥に進み、残されたのは俺とライダーだけだ。
contexts.english: Tohsaka's gone, leaving only me.

contexts.japanese: 「殺す、とは聞き捨てなりませんね。貴方が手にかけるのはこの道を通る者のみ。彼がこの場に留まるのなら、貴方に襲われる事はない筈ですが」
contexts.english: "Did I hear you correctly? You said that you would only kill those who attempt to pass. If he stays here, you should not attack him."

contexts.japanese: 違いますか、ライダー」
contexts.english: Am I wrong, Rider?"

findings.description: Hypothetical worldwide mage drain becomes actual gathering to use reserve.
findings.sourceReading: Even all mages worldwide gathering and drawing freely would not exhaust store.
findings.explanation: Hypothetical worldwide mage drain becomes actual gathering to use reserve.

contexts.japanese: 世界中の魔術師がここに集まって、好き勝手魔力をくみ上げようと尽きない貯蔵量。
contexts.english: an inexhaustible resource that mages from around the world gather here to use.

findings.description: Cup-of-Heaven threat loses this-me self-identification.
findings.sourceReading: 天の杯 bears このわたし ruby: she tells Rin to drown in this me, identifying engulfing vessel with herself.
findings.explanation: Cup-of-Heaven threat loses this-me self-identification.

contexts.japanese: 今度は誰も助けに来ない。湖に落ちた虫みたいに、天の杯に溺れなさい」
contexts.english: No one's coming to save you this time. Drown in the Cup of Heaven, like a bug fallen into a lake."

findings.description: Grinding teeth at resemblance becomes suppressing the words.
findings.sourceReading: Sakura grinds her teeth thinking it is like Excalibur's very light.
findings.explanation: Grinding teeth at resemblance becomes suppressing the words.

contexts.japanese: セイバーの宝具、エクスカリバーの光そのものではないか、と少女は歯を軋ませる。
contexts.english: She stops herself from saying that it's almost exactly like Saber's Excalibur.

findings.description: Refusal to forgive that woman loses written layer.
findings.sourceReading: Base says not forgive that woman, while ruby reads sister and start of noisy/shut-up.
findings.explanation: Refusal to forgive that woman loses written layer.

contexts.japanese: —あの女は、許さない。
contexts.english: Shut up, Nee-san.

findings.description: Obsession keeping him in the world becomes obsession alone remaining intact.
findings.sourceReading: Only through that obsession he still remains in this world.
findings.explanation: Obsession keeping him in the world becomes obsession alone remaining intact.

contexts.japanese: ただ、その執念だけで、未だこの世に留まっていた。
contexts.english: Only its obsession is still intact.

contexts.japanese: マキリ臓硯。魂をこの世に留める本体を潰された老魔術師は、その執念だけでこの世界に残留していた。
contexts.english: Zouken Makiri. The old mage, his main body anchoring his soul having been crushed, clings to this world by his obsession alone.

findings.description: Golden saint reduced to golden woman.
findings.sourceReading: The remembered Einzbern woman is explicitly 黄金の聖女, a golden holy woman/saint.
findings.explanation: Golden saint reduced to golden woman.

contexts.japanese: いつの時も色褪せずに心にいた、アインツベルンの黄金の聖女。
contexts.english: The golden Einzbern woman who has never faded from his mind to this day.

findings.description: Missing relative clause and lost continuing participation.
findings.sourceReading: One cornerstone among the miracle-seeking mages, a survivor who continued as participant while being an observer, crumbles.
findings.explanation: Missing relative clause and lost continuing participation.

contexts.japanese: 奇蹟を求めた魔術師たちの一角、生きながらえ当事者であり続けた傍観者が崩れていく。
contexts.english: One of the mages sought a miracle, an observer who was there at the very beginning, crumbles away.

findings.description: Sword/iron dual layer reduced to steel alone.
findings.sourceReading: Base 剣 says sword while ruby てつ says iron/metal: only his face has not become sword/iron yet.
findings.explanation: Sword/iron dual layer reduced to steel alone.

contexts.japanese: 顔だけはまだ剣になっていない。
contexts.english: My face alone hasn't turned to steel yet.

findings.description: Duty/wish double layer reduced to wish alone.
findings.sourceReading: Written 責務 is responsibility/duty, with spoken ruby のぞみ wish. Last Master must fulfill both superimposed senses before the Grail.
findings.explanation: Duty/wish double layer reduced to wish alone.

contexts.japanese: 聖杯を前にし、その責務を果たすがいい」
contexts.english: Go before the Holy Grail and fulfill your wish."

findings.description: Sick Sakura worrying about pale caregiver becomes Rin doing Shirou a favor.
findings.sourceReading: If his face is pale/ringed, even Sakura receiving care will feel obliged to worry about him.
findings.explanation: Sick Sakura worrying about pale caregiver becomes Rin doing Shirou a favor.

contexts.japanese: ……まったく、嘘だと思うなら鏡を見てきなさい。顔面蒼白で目にクマ作ってたら、看病される桜だって気を遣うわ」
contexts.english: ...If you think I'm lying, go take a look in the mirror. You're deathly pale and got rings around your eyes like a raccoon. I'm doing you a favor by taking care of Sakura."

findings.description: Resentment at being bested becomes practice until satisfied.
findings.sourceReading: She wants practice because she cannot bear remaining on losing end of Rider encounter.
findings.explanation: Resentment at being bested becomes practice until satisfied.

contexts.japanese: おまえ、単にやられっぱなしじゃ気が済まないから練習したいだけだろ」
contexts.english: You just wanna practice on me until you're satisfied!"

findings.description: Easy catch if running becomes urgent requirement.
findings.sourceReading: Anyway if she runs she can immediately catch up.
findings.explanation: Easy catch if running becomes urgent requirement.

contexts.japanese: ともあれ、走ればすぐに追いつける。
contexts.english: Anyway, she needs to catch up to him right away.

findings.description: Sakura not collapsing of herself omitted.
findings.sourceReading: Zouken thought easy collapse but underestimated her spirit: she never falls apart of herself.
findings.explanation: Sakura not collapsing of herself omitted.

contexts.japanese: 『いやはや、これはワシの過ちじゃ。アレの精神力を甘くみておった。簡単に決壊すると思ったが、アレは決して自分から崩れはしない。
contexts.english: "This was my mistake, I admit. I underestimated her willpower.

findings.description: Acquiring the key becomes unlocking the gate. This concerns the ritual's predicted progression and belongs outside this character dossier.
findings.sourceReading: Zouken predicts taking Archer's soul from the girl and seizing the key that leads to the gate.
findings.explanation: Acquiring the key becomes unlocking the gate. This concerns the ritual's predicted progression and belongs outside this character dossier.

contexts.japanese: アインツベルンの聖杯。あの小娘が取り込んだアーチャーの魂を取り込み、門に至る鍵を奪う。
contexts.english: The Einzbern Grail. Once she absorbs that little girl and the Archer she took, Sakura will unlock the gate.

findings.description: Murmured judgment becomes unspoken appraisal.
findings.sourceReading: Illya murmurs 滑稽ね, comical, aloud.
findings.explanation: Murmured judgment becomes unspoken appraisal.

contexts.japanese: 滑稽ね、とイリヤは呟く。
contexts.english: She finds it rather comical.

findings.description: Prior offense prompting Rin to guard Illya becomes Sakura needing caution toward Illya.
findings.sourceReading: Even otherwise Sakura already has one previous offense, so guarding Illya is natural for Rin.
findings.explanation: Prior offense prompting Rin to guard Illya becomes Sakura needing caution toward Illya.

contexts.japanese: 「まあね。わたしには士郎と違って、アンタを助ける理由がないもの。いよいよとなったらイリヤを攫いに来るのは明白でしょ。そうでなくても一度前科があるんだから、イリヤを見張るのは当然よ」
contexts.english: "Pretty much. Unlike Shirou, I don't have any reason to save you. It was obvious that you'd come to take Illya once things started rolling. Even if you didn't, you had plenty of reason to be cautious of her."

findings.description: Emotionless voice's chilling question becomes Rin taking it in stride.
findings.sourceReading: Question causes chill because Sakura's voice is emotionless; clause leads into Rin's firm response.
findings.explanation: Emotionless voice's chilling question becomes Rin taking it in stride.

contexts.japanese: それ故に寒気のする質問に、
contexts.english: Rin takes the question in stride.

contexts.japanese: 感情のない声。
contexts.english: Her voice contains no emotion.

findings.description: Biting back an insult becomes enduring humiliation.
findings.sourceReading: Following interrupted you-little insult, Rin glares while suppressing insult she would utter.
findings.explanation: Biting back an insult becomes enduring humiliation.

contexts.japanese: 侮辱をかみ殺しながら、凛は桜を睨み返す。
contexts.english: Rin glares at Sakura, enduring the humiliation.
"You...little..."

findings.description: Pressing heart through chest disappears into chest's confinement.
findings.sourceReading: Heart is pressed from above chest while beating warning, before later wall-supported walking; exact hand/agent not independently specified.
findings.explanation: Pressing heart through chest disappears into chest's confinement.

contexts.japanese: 胸の上から押さえつけた心臓は、ずいぶん前から慌ただしく危険信号を送っている。
contexts.english: Her heart's been drumming a warning signal for some time from within the confines of her chest.

findings.description: Must stop old man becomes Sakura cannot stop.
findings.sourceReading: She must stop the old man who made her Master even at cost of mutual destruction.
findings.explanation: Must stop old man becomes Sakura cannot stop.

contexts.japanese: 自分をマスターにしたあの老人を、刺し違えてでも止めなくてはいけない。
contexts.english: She can't stop, even if she and the old man who turned her into a Master end up killing each other.

findings.description: One colored person becomes generic foreign element.
findings.sourceReading: Power couldn't withstand even one color-bearing alien individual, explicitly counted 一人.
findings.explanation: One colored person becomes generic foreign element.

contexts.japanese: そこに一粒の毒が混ざった程度で、穢れなきモノは全て変色した。なにしろ無色だからな。どれほど深遠で広大だろうと、たった一人の、色のついた異分子には敵わなかったという訳だ」
contexts.english: All it took was a single drop of poison to taint that pure vessel. It was colorless, as you know. No matter how vast or unfathomable it was, it was unable to tolerate a single foreign element."

findings.description: Sakura is called a host with the reading 'Master' in Japanese; English retains only 'host.' The local pairing of receptacle and contractual role is lost, although a contract is mentioned shortly afterward.
findings.sourceReading: The written 'host' is paired with the reading 'Master,' placing Sakura's receptacle role alongside a contractual designation as power passes to her.
findings.explanation: Sakura is called a host with the reading 'Master' in Japanese; English retains only 'host.' The local pairing of receptacle and contractual role is lost, although a contract is mentioned shortly afterward.

contexts.japanese: 寄り代への侵食……間桐桜に力の継承が済んでしまえば、彼女自身があの影に変貌する」
contexts.english: Once it consumes its host, once Sakura Matou inherits its power, she will transform into the Shadow."

findings.description: Palm-sized true body and brain-worm designation omitted.
findings.sourceReading: Soul-container brain worm's hiding location unknown; palm-sized main body anchors soul and must be found or soul purified.
findings.explanation: Palm-sized true body and brain-worm designation omitted.

contexts.japanese: 「そうだ。アレの本体は人体に寄生する蟲だからな。魂の容器にあたる脳虫が何処に潜んでいるかは知れんが、ソレが生きている限り人体の乗っ取りは易い。
contexts.english: "Yes. He is an insect which parasitizes human bodies. I do not know which insect contains his mind and soul, but it is easy for him to transfer himself to a new body as long as it is intact.

contexts.japanese: 間桐臓硯はある意味不老不死だ。魂を世に留めている手のひらほどの本体を探し出すか、魂そのものを浄化させなければ完全には滅ぼせん」
contexts.english: He is immortal, in a way. He will never completely disappear unless you find the main body which anchors his soul, or cleanse his soul itself."

findings.description: Unanswering brother becomes wordless girl's look.
findings.sourceReading: Girl raises body and looks at silent/non-speaking brother, cue of collapse.
findings.explanation: Unanswering brother becomes wordless girl's look.

contexts.japanese: 少女は体を起こして、物言わぬ兄を見つめた。
contexts.english: The girl rises and looks wordlessly at the man.

findings.description: Inferred sharp thread becomes generic direct sharp strike.
findings.sourceReading: Seems head hit with extremely sharp string/thread, inferred from pencil-like fine wound and brain depth.
findings.explanation: Inferred sharp thread becomes generic direct sharp strike.

contexts.japanese: ものすごく鋭利なヒモで、ぱしん、と頭を叩かれたのだろう。
contexts.english: Something incredibly sharp hit him in the head,

contexts.japanese: 線は脳にまで達し、けれど細すぎる傷口は中身を零すことはせず、赤々とした筋だけを流している。
contexts.english: Marked by flowing red liquid, the line reached his brain, but it's so thin that nothing leaks from the wound.

findings.description: Failure even to conceive of evasion becomes merely not trying.
findings.sourceReading: He did not think of himself evading, while his thoughts are in pieces.
findings.explanation: Failure even to conceive of evasion becomes merely not trying.

contexts.japanese: 自分が避ける事は考えつけなかった。
contexts.english: I don't even try to evade it.

contexts.japanese: ボロボロの思考のまま、遠坂を弾き飛ばした。
contexts.english: In my battered mental state, I shove Tohsaka away.

findings.description: Irrecoverably disabling Rin is softened to neutralizing her.
findings.sourceReading: 再起不能 specifies making Rin unable to recover/get back up, alongside killing Shirou and absorbing Rider.
findings.explanation: Irrecoverably disabling Rin is softened to neutralizing her.

contexts.japanese: 「言葉通りの意味よ。ライダーを取り込んでもシロウを殺してもリンを再起不能にしても、今のサクラには意味がないってコト。時間の無駄だし、八つ当たりはそのあたりにしておいたら？」
contexts.english: "Exactly what I said. You can consume Rider, kill Shirou, and neutralize Rin, but it's pointless to you right now. You're just wasting time, so why don't you stop the temper tantrum already?"

findings.description: Fetching ceremonial clothing is replaced by escorting Illya.
findings.sourceReading: Ceremonial/formal dress isn't here; if Sakura wants to open the gate as successor, they must go to Illya's castle to fetch it.
findings.explanation: Fetching ceremonial clothing is replaced by escorting Illya.

contexts.japanese: けど正装はここにはないの。サクラが後継者として門を開きたいんなら、わたしの城まで取りに行かないと」
contexts.english: But my dress isn't here. If you want to open the gate as a successor, you'll need to take me to my castle."

contexts.japanese: 「……いいでしょう。自分で探す手間が省けますから。
contexts.english: "...Fine. It saves me the trouble of looking for it myself.

findings.description: Lead-heavy whole-body impairment disappears during renewed pursuit.
findings.sourceReading: His whole body feels like lead, and nausea/chills make his brain spin, as he chases the girls.
findings.explanation: Lead-heavy whole-body impairment disappears during renewed pursuit.

contexts.japanese: 全身鉛、吐き気と悪寒で脳みそがぐるんぐるんの状態で、遠ざかっていく二人を追いかける。
contexts.english: I chase after them with reckless abandon, pushing through the nausea, the chill, and my soup-like brain.

findings.description: Explicit retraction of attack threat becomes generic amendment.
findings.sourceReading: Rider withdraws the statement about attacking him, then gives conditional cooperation as long as he protects Sakura.
findings.explanation: Explicit retraction of attack threat becomes generic amendment.

contexts.japanese: 「……そうですね。貴方を襲う、というのは撤回します。
contexts.english: "...All right. Allow me to amend that statement.

contexts.japanese: 貴方がサクラを守るかぎり、私たちは協力者です。今後ともよろしくお願いします」
contexts.english: As long as you protect Sakura, I will cooperate with you. I hope you will find that satisfactory."

findings.description: Shirou's stated atonement for Saber's death becomes repayment for her cooperation. 'Also' becomes 'the only way,' changing both the expressed cost of following him and his reason for continuing.
findings.sourceReading: Continuing the fight is also atonement toward Saber, whom Shirou understands to have died after going along with his selfishness.
findings.explanation: Shirou's stated atonement for Saber's death becomes repayment for her cooperation. 'Also' becomes 'the only way,' changing both the expressed cost of following him and his reason for continuing.

contexts.japanese: ……それが俺の我が侭につき合い、命を落としたセイバーへの償いでもある。
contexts.english: ...It's the only way I can repay Saber for going along with my selfishness.

findings.description: Abject clinging to ground becomes invented hair-and-limbs tumble.
findings.sourceReading: Body stumbles over dark longing, falls immediately and abjectly clings to ground.
findings.explanation: Abject clinging to ground becomes invented hair-and-limbs tumble.

contexts.japanese: 体は昏い恋しさに躓いてすぐに倒れ、卑しく地面にすがりつく。
contexts.english: The dark longing makes her stumble, and she tumbles to the ground in a tangle of hair and limbs.

findings.description: Sakura's surprise at Rider's unsolicited concern becomes surprise that Rider has offered any suggestion. This weakens the explicit recognition of care between them.
findings.sourceReading: What surprises Sakura is Rider taking the initiative to express concern for her in this way.
findings.explanation: Sakura's surprise at Rider's unsolicited concern becomes surprise that Rider has offered any suggestion. This weakens the explicit recognition of care between them.

contexts.japanese: それが今のように、自ら彼女を案じるなど今までなかった事だ。
contexts.english: Until now, she's never made so much as a suggestion.

findings.description: Rin still ends the deadlock first, but break the ice omits her release of her fighting stance. Both versions keep Shirou lowering his wooden sword after her request.
findings.sourceReading: Rin asks Shirou to lower the sword and is the first to release her stance; he then lowers his wooden sword. The omitted detail is her physical de-escalation, not all of her initiative.
findings.explanation: Rin still ends the deadlock first, but break the ice omits her release of her fighting stance. Both versions keep Shirou lowering his wooden sword after her request.

contexts.japanese: ……先に構えを解いたのは遠坂だった。
contexts.english: Tohsaka's the first to break the ice.

contexts.japanese: 「……ちょっと。いいかげん、それ下げてくれない？　お化け屋敷じゃないんだから」
contexts.english: "...Hold on. Would you put that down? We're not in a haunted house."

contexts.japanese: 釣られて木刀を下げる。
contexts.english: I lower the wooden sword as asked.

findings.description: Shirou's objection to either girl being injured becomes a warning that Rin will be hurt. His explicit concern for Illya within this appeal disappears.
findings.sourceReading: Shirou objects because either Rin or Illya will be injured if they fight.
findings.explanation: Shirou's objection to either girl being injured becomes a warning that Rin will be hurt. His explicit concern for Illya within this appeal disappears.

contexts.japanese: 「それもあるけど。遠坂、イリヤと戦ったらただじゃ済まないぞ。始めたらどっちかが必ず傷を負う。そういうのは嫌だ。俺は、もともと」
contexts.english: "That too. But Tohsaka, you won't get out unscathed if you fight her. You're bound to get hurt once you start. I don't want that to happen. To begin with—"

findings.description: The swordsman's cut through Berserker's unguarded body disappears.
findings.sourceReading: Black armor passes through greatsword and debris, then flashes a cut across the exposed body.
findings.explanation: The swordsman's cut through Berserker's unguarded body disappears.

contexts.japanese: 吹き荒ぶ風の元凶はあの黒い剣士なのか、黒い甲冑はバーサーカーの大剣と土塊をすり抜け、無防備な体を一閃する。
contexts.english: The black-armored Servant breezes past Berserker's greatsword and earthen assault, as if it's the source of this raging wind.

contexts.japanese: それを、黒い剣士は苦もなく切断する。
contexts.english: And the black swordsman easily slices it open.

findings.description: The sizzling instant of the left-side disappearance vanishes.
findings.sourceReading: Everything beyond left shoulder disappears cleanly with a brief sizzling sound.
findings.explanation: The sizzling instant of the left-side disappearance vanishes.

contexts.japanese: じゅっ、と音をたててキレイさっぱり消え去った。
contexts.english: It's all gone.

findings.description: The shared objective survives, but the English leaves out Rin's explicit limit: cooperating until Zouken is defeated.
findings.sourceReading: Rin offers cooperation until their shared objective of defeating Zouken is achieved.
findings.explanation: The shared objective survives, but the English leaves out Rin's explicit limit: cooperating until Zouken is defeated.

contexts.japanese: だいたいね、貴方だけじゃ心許ないでしょ。臓硯を倒すって目的は一緒なんだし、それまで手を組んであげてもいいってコト！」
contexts.english: I bet you aren't feeling great about fighting alone, either. We both want to take down Zouken, so I'll team up with you if that's what you want!"

contexts.japanese: 「そうよ、協力してあげてもいいって言ってるのっ！
contexts.english: "Yeah, I'm saying that I'll work together with you!

findings.description: Illya's second emphatic embrace disappears.
findings.sourceReading: Illya clings to Shirou with the biggest possible smile after promising to protect him from Rin.
findings.explanation: Illya's second emphatic embrace disappears.

contexts.japanese: にぱっ、とこれ以上ない笑顔で抱きついてくるイリヤ。
contexts.english: Illya beams.

findings.description: The explanation of Illya's fear loses the immediate threat to her own life. It describes her witnessing Berserker's death instead of facing both his defeat and approaching death herself.
findings.sourceReading: Illya faces both her Servant's defeat and death immediately threatening her.
findings.explanation: The explanation of Illya's fear loses the immediate threat to her own life. It describes her witnessing Berserker's death instead of facing both his defeat and approaching death herself.

contexts.japanese: 自らのサーヴァントの敗北と、目前に迫った死。
contexts.english: Illya just watched her Servant die in battle.

findings.description: A precise absolute image of surviving and defeating Saber becomes generic full commitment.
findings.sourceReading: Shirou believes he cannot even contest Saber unless he fights under an absolute image in which he himself survives and defeats the enemy.
findings.explanation: A precise absolute image of surviving and defeating Saber becomes generic full commitment.

contexts.japanese: その、絶対のイメージの下で斬り合わなければ、セイバーとは勝負にもなり得ない—！
contexts.english: Unless I imagine myself fully committing to this, I don't have a chance against her...!

contexts.japanese: 自分は生き延びて敵を倒す。
contexts.english: I'll defeat my enemy and survive.

findings.description: Rider carrying the group becomes carrying Shirou alone.
findings.sourceReading: Rider confirms that she transported Shirou and the others from the forest to the church under Sakura's order.
findings.explanation: Rider carrying the group becomes carrying Shirou alone.

contexts.japanese: 「……そうですね。貴方たちを運んだのは私です。サクラは貴方を守れと言った。私はサーヴァントとして、彼女の命に従ったまでです」
contexts.english: "...Yes. I carried you there. Sakura told me to protect you. I merely obeyed her order, as her Servant."

findings.description: Rider's claim that Sakura wants Shirou alive beside her omits alive.
findings.sourceReading: Rider defines Sakura's happiness as Shirou living and remaining at her side, and claims she wants nothing else.
findings.explanation: Rider's claim that Sakura wants Shirou alive beside her omits alive.

contexts.japanese: サクラの幸福は、貴方が生きて傍にいてくれる、という事。それ以外に彼女が望むものなどない」
contexts.english: What makes Sakura happy is having you by her side. She does not wish for anything else."

findings.description: White, blindness-like vision after severing shared sight becomes generic vertigo.
findings.sourceReading: Forcibly breaking visual sharing leaves Sakura's sight clouded white as if blind.
findings.explanation: White, blindness-like vision after severing shared sight becomes generic vertigo.

contexts.japanese: サーヴァントと共有していた視覚を強引に断った為、視界は失明したかのように白濁としている。
contexts.english: She's hit by the vertigo of suddenly severing her senses from that of her Servant.

findings.description: The second route to saving Sakura loses the requirement that someone obtain the Grail.
findings.sourceReading: Either Sakura must obtain the Grail, or a person who intends to save her must obtain it.
findings.explanation: The second route to saving Sakura loses the requirement that someone obtain the Grail.

contexts.japanese: 桜を救いたいのなら、それは桜が聖杯を手に入れるか、それとも—桜を助ける気がある人間が聖杯を手に入れるしかない。
contexts.english: If we want to save Sakura, then either Sakura has to win the Holy Grail, or someone willing to help her.

findings.description: Rin's reminder that Illya once nearly killed Shirou disappears.
findings.sourceReading: Rin provocatively says Illya is returning to her castle without gratitude after being saved by Shirou, whom she once nearly killed.
findings.explanation: Rin's reminder that Illya once nearly killed Shirou disappears.

contexts.japanese: 「あーら、やっぱりそうなんだ。一度殺しかけた士郎に助けられたクセに、恩も感じずにお城に戻るワケね。
contexts.english: "Oh wow, really? Shirou saved your life, but you're just gonna run back to the castle without an ounce of gratitude.

findings.description: Kirei's birth during his father's pilgrimage becomes birth to a traveling priest.
findings.sourceReading: He was born in 1967 while his father was on religious pilgrimage.
findings.explanation: Kirei's birth during his father's pilgrimage becomes birth to a traveling priest.

contexts.japanese: 男は１９６７年、父親が巡礼中に授かった子供だった。
contexts.english: He was born to a traveling priest in the year 1967.

findings.description: The father's thorn-heeled pilgrimage disappears.
findings.sourceReading: Over more than ten years Kirei's father travels sacred sites with thorn-like suffering at his heels before the moon-distance hyperbole.
findings.explanation: The father's thorn-heeled pilgrimage disappears.

contexts.japanese: 父は十数年をかけて、茨の踵で聖地を巡礼した。
contexts.english: His father was on a pilgrimage to holy places for over ten years.

findings.description: Illya's offer to treat Sakura as human becomes unspecified special treatment. The English retains condescension but removes the precise insult that Sakura turns back on her.
findings.sourceReading: Illya grants Sakura the supposed exception of being treated as human because she knows Shirou.
findings.explanation: Illya's offer to treat Sakura as human becomes unspecified special treatment. The English retains condescension but removes the precise insult that Sakura turns back on her.

contexts.japanese: 「よろしくサクラ。マキリの娘だそうだけど、軽蔑はしないであげるわ。いちおうシロウの知り合いみたいだし、特別に人間扱いしてあげる」
contexts.english: "Hi, Sakura. I heard you're a daughter of the Makiris, but I won't hold that against you. You seem like you know Shirou, so I'll give you special treatment."

findings.description: Sakura silently continuing to eat after the shock becomes merely eating too.
findings.sourceReading: Crushed by Rin's superior cooking, Sakura says no more and wordlessly devotes herself to moving food into her mouth.
findings.explanation: Sakura silently continuing to eat after the shock becomes merely eating too.

contexts.japanese: ショックで打ちひしがれた桜は、それきりモクモクと料理を口に運ぶだけになった。
contexts.english: Sakura was stunned, but she still ended up eating the food too.

findings.description: Sakura's promise to strike back at Rin with Shirou-taught cooking becomes a promise to make his favorites. Her grin and the following mock battle talk remain, but their setup is missing.
findings.sourceReading: Sakura proposes playful retaliation against Rin through a breakfast made using what Shirou taught her. Her mischievous grin and their subsequent talk of striking back confirm the competitive framing.
findings.explanation: Sakura's promise to strike back at Rin with Shirou-taught cooking becomes a promise to make his favorites. Her grin and the following mock battle talk remain, but their setup is missing.

contexts.japanese: 今夜は遠坂先輩にご馳走してもらいましたから、明日の朝はわたしが受け持ちますね。先輩仕込みの朝食で仕返ししてあげちゃいます」
contexts.english: Since Tohsaka-senpai took care of us tonight, I'll make breakfast tomorrow morning. I'll cook the things you like for breakfast."

findings.description: Shirou's certainty that none of the account was false disappears.
findings.sourceReading: What Shirou can tell is that nothing in Kirei's account was a lie, and that the otherwise indifferent man bears anger toward Kiritsugu.
findings.explanation: Shirou's certainty that none of the account was false disappears.

contexts.japanese: ……判るのは今の話に何一つ嘘がなかった事と—
contexts.english: But, the one thing that I do know for certain is...

findings.description: The defining examples of human pillars and sacrifices disappear.
findings.sourceReading: Kirei says, succinctly, that human pillars and sacrificial victims are examples of the Heroic Spirits called Anti-Heroes.
findings.explanation: The defining examples of human pillars and sacrifices disappear.

contexts.japanese: 「そういったものが反英雄と呼ばれる英霊だ。端的に言えば人柱や生贄がこれにあたる」
contexts.english: "Such Heroic Spirits tend to be labeled as Anti-Heroes."

findings.description: Sacrifices to be ignored become excess and hypocrisy.
findings.sourceReading: In Kiritsugu's too-simple design, the surplus parts that do not fit its perfect shape are sacrifices; the text overlays disposing of them with ignoring them.
findings.explanation: Sacrifices to be ignored become excess and hypocrisy.

contexts.japanese: 「判らずともいい。ただ衛宮切嗣の願いは“平和”だった。実にシンプルだろう。シンプルすぎるが故に、複雑な世の中ではパーツが余ってしまう。その完璧な形に入りきれない余分は処分するしかない」
contexts.english: "You don't have to understand. Kiritsugu Emiya's wish was, in a word, 'peace.' Very simple, isn't it? So simple, in fact, that in a complex world it renders much unneeded. All he could do was dispose of or ignore all the excess and hypocrisy that didn't fit into his perfect ideal."

findings.description: A millennium without branches or intermarriage becomes only an unfragmented bloodline.
findings.sourceReading: Few lineages last a thousand years without creating branch houses and without mixing with outsiders.
findings.explanation: A millennium without branches or intermarriage becomes only an unfragmented bloodline.

contexts.japanese: 「……といっても、もともとこの聖杯はアインツベルンが考案したものだ。彼の一族の歴史は一千年。分家も持たず、他と交わらずに一千の年月を重ねた家系は少ない」
contexts.english: "...That said, the Einzberns originally conceived this Holy Grail. They have a thousand years of history. Few mage lineages have persisted for a millennium without fragmenting their bloodlines."

findings.description: Risking Shirou's own life each night becomes weighing lives in general.
findings.sourceReading: Kirei tells Shirou, like Kiritsugu, to put his own life on the scales night after night and lure out his target.
findings.explanation: Risking Shirou's own life each night becomes weighing lives in general.

contexts.japanese: 「十分だ。それがおまえの戦う意義ならば、死を賭して戦うがいい。長引けばそれだけ犠牲者は出る。切嗣と同じよう、夜毎己が命を秤にかけて標的を誘き寄せろ」
contexts.english: "That is sufficient. If that is what drives you, then fight like your life depends on it. The longer it lasts, the more victims there will be. Do as Kiritsugu did and weigh lives on a balance, all to lure out your objective."

findings.description: Shinji's use of people to summon spectators disappears.
findings.sourceReading: Shinji says he called people there because he wanted to see Servants fight.
findings.explanation: Shinji's use of people to summon spectators disappears.

contexts.japanese: 「ほら、戦わせてみようぜ衛宮。僕はサーヴァント同士の戦いが見たくて人を呼んだんだ。おまえだってマスターだろ？　なのにぶるぶる震えてさ、そんなんじゃそこの女と変わらないじゃないか！」
contexts.english: "C'mon, show me what you got, Emiya. I went to all this trouble because I want to see Servants fight. Aren't you a Master? What are you shaking in your boots for? Makes you no different from that 'girl' there!"

findings.description: A death-premised command moving Rider becomes her death growing more certain.
findings.sourceReading: Rider's body moves in response to an order premised on her death: die while taking Saber with her.
findings.explanation: A death-premised command moving Rider becomes her death growing more certain.

contexts.japanese: —死を前提とした命令に、ライダーの体が動く。
contexts.english: Her body begins to move, her death ever more certain.

findings.description: Zouken's claim that he has been away for roughly ten years disappears. The same interval instead describes the apprentice's growth, changing his explanation for his limited knowledge.
findings.sourceReading: Zouken attributes his unfamiliarity with the previous head's apprentice to having been away for about ten years.
findings.explanation: Zouken's claim that he has been away for roughly ten years disappears. The same interval instead describes the apprentice's growth, changing his explanation for his limited knowledge.

contexts.japanese: ここ十年ばかり留守にしておった故、彼奴の弟子がどれほどの器かは見知らぬが」
contexts.english: I wonder how much of a mage their apprentice has grown into these past ten years."

findings.description: Not knowing that Matou practices magecraft becomes merely not being taught its arts.
findings.sourceReading: Zouken claims the sibling not chosen as heir does not even know that the Matou household belongs to the magical path.
findings.explanation: Not knowing that Matou practices magecraft becomes merely not being taught its arts.

contexts.japanese: 「慎二はマスターである以上、答えは明白であろう。後継者に選ばれなかった片割れは、間桐の家が魔道である事も知らぬわ。
contexts.english: "Shinji is the Master, so the conclusion is obvious. A sibling not even chosen as the heir would not be inducted into our arts.

findings.description: No mana supply becomes no extra mana.
findings.sourceReading: Saber receives no magical energy from Shirou and must spend her own reserves merely maintaining existence.
findings.explanation: No mana supply becomes no extra mana.

contexts.japanese: 俺からの魔力提供がないセイバーは、それこそ日々『ここにいる』だけで精一杯なのだ。
contexts.english: Without any extra magical energy from me, it takes all of Saber's power just to exist.

findings.description: Saber kneeling formally at the table becomes merely sitting with perfect posture.
findings.sourceReading: She sits seiza in front of the table, a specific floor-seated kneeling position.
findings.explanation: Saber kneeling formally at the table becomes merely sitting with perfect posture.

contexts.japanese: 不満げにこぼして、セイバーは行儀よくテーブルの前に正座する。
contexts.english: Looking a little displeased, Saber politely takes a seat at the dining table, her posture perfect.

findings.description: Ten minutes of silence becomes the end of Shirou's explanation.
findings.sourceReading: It has already been ten minutes since he gave the brief lodging explanation.
findings.explanation: Ten minutes of silence becomes the end of Shirou's explanation.

contexts.japanese: と説明してからはや十分。
contexts.english: That's all the explanation I give.

findings.description: Shirou's remark that Saber is unsociable like her name disappears.
findings.sourceReading: He calls the name unusual, says she is as blunt or unsociable as the name suggests, but guarantees she is a good person and asks Sakura to teach her Japan.
findings.explanation: Shirou's remark that Saber is unsociable like her name disappears.

contexts.japanese: 「ん？　ああ、変わった名前だろ。名前通り無愛想だけど、いいヤツなのは保証する。あんまり日本になれてないんでおかしなところもあるけど、桜が教えてくれると助かる」
contexts.english: "Hm? Oh, yeah. Her name sounds kinda strange, but I guarantee that she's good people. She might act a little weird because she isn't used to Japan yet, but I'd appreciate it if you'd help her out."

findings.description: Inviting Rin inside because of a small connection becomes her stopping by the other day.
findings.sourceReading: Shirou's cover story says a minor connection led him to have Rin come into the house.
findings.explanation: Inviting Rin inside because of a small connection becomes her stopping by the other day.

contexts.japanese: 「ああ。ちょっとした縁で家にあがってもらったんだ。
contexts.english: "Yeah. She stopped by the other day.

findings.description: Sakura holding her own body disappears from the intact narration.
findings.sourceReading: With head lowered, Sakura stays still while pressing or holding her body, before the damaged later line elaborates her self-embrace.
findings.explanation: Sakura holding her own body disappears from the intact narration.

contexts.japanese: 俯いたまま、桜はじっと体を押さえる。
contexts.english: Sakura suddenly goes still, looking downcast.

findings.description: Kiritsugu making Grail-dependent people his enemies becomes merely defying the Grail.
findings.sourceReading: Kiritsugu turned those beings or people who could only be saved by the Grail against himself and destroyed it.
findings.explanation: Kiritsugu making Grail-dependent people his enemies becomes merely defying the Grail.

contexts.japanese: 切嗣はそれを敵に回して、聖杯を破壊した。
contexts.english: My old man defied the grail and chose to destroy it instead.

findings.description: Kirei's single spoken I see becomes a silent nod.
findings.sourceReading: He gives no extended answer, but does say one word, 'I see,' while nodding.
findings.explanation: Kirei's single spoken I see becomes a silent nod.

contexts.japanese: 神父は何も言わない。
contexts.english: The priest says nothing.

contexts.japanese: ただ一言、そうか、と頷いただけだ。
contexts.english: He merely nods in acknowledgement.

findings.description: Shirou's goal equaling ancient wishes and requiring opposition becomes respect for others' reasons.
findings.sourceReading: Shirou says protecting people and becoming a champion of justice is not inferior; therefore, even against five-hundred- or thousand-year wishes, he must make them enemies and fight.
findings.explanation: Shirou's goal equaling ancient wishes and requiring opposition becomes respect for others' reasons.

contexts.japanese: それが他の連中に劣っているとは思えない。なら相手が五百年だろうが一千年だろうが、向こうに回して戦わなくちゃいけないと思うんだ」
contexts.english: That doesn't mean I think any less of the others. They all have their own reasons for fighting. Some have been after the Grail for five hundred years or even a thousand."

findings.description: The English substitutes a sense of Saber's reality for explicit awareness of her as a woman. The surrounding attraction remains, and this belongs in a dossier about Shirou's perception.
findings.sourceReading: The everyday reality of Saber's clothes makes Shirou involuntarily conscious of her as a woman.
findings.explanation: The English substitutes a sense of Saber's reality for explicit awareness of her as a woman. The surrounding attraction remains, and this belongs in a dossier about Shirou's perception.

contexts.japanese: セイバーの服装はあまりにも現実感がありすぎて、否応なしに異性を意識してしまうのだ。
contexts.english: With Saber in that outfit, I can't help but actually think she's real now.

findings.description: Serving under an exchange condition becomes serving for unspecified reasons.
findings.sourceReading: Shirou understands that Heroic Spirits have their own objective and serve Masters as the other side of a bargain.
findings.explanation: Serving under an exchange condition becomes serving for unspecified reasons.

contexts.japanese: 彼らにも目的があるから、交換条件としてマスターに仕えている。
contexts.english: They have their own reasons for serving Masters.

findings.description: Shirou's question about refusing no means is left unfinished in English.
findings.sourceReading: He asks whether using every possible means means choosing no limits to win, then begins an example.
findings.explanation: Shirou's question about refusing no means is left unfinished in English.

contexts.japanese: 可能である全ての手段っと言ったな。それは勝つ為には手段を選ばないって事か。たとえば—」
contexts.english: You said any means possible, right? Does that mean you..."

findings.description: Reaching the divine domain by an individual's power alone loses the individual-power condition.
findings.sourceReading: Whatever the means, each rose as far as the divine realm solely by one person's power.
findings.explanation: Reaching the divine domain by an individual's power alone loses the individual-power condition.

contexts.japanese: どのような手段であれ、一個人の力だけで神域まで上り詰めた存在です」
contexts.english: Whatever the means, we are beings who have sublimated to deity-esque status."

findings.description: Killing by another means becomes merely finding another way.
findings.sourceReading: If a foe cannot be beaten with a sword, Shirou realizes one can cut off that foe's life by something other than a sword.
findings.explanation: Killing by another means becomes merely finding another way.

contexts.japanese: 剣で敵わない相手なら、剣以外で敵の息の根を断つだけの話じゃないか。
contexts.english: If you can't beat your opponent with a sword, you just have to come up with another way.

findings.description: Shirou's concern about taking something from Saber becomes generic help and excuse-making.
findings.sourceReading: He apologizes that when he gets hurt on his own, he receives or takes something from Saber.
findings.explanation: Shirou's concern about taking something from Saber becomes generic help and excuse-making.

contexts.japanese: 「分かってる。俺がかってにケガして、それでセイバーから何かを貰ってる、なんていうのは申し訳ない」
contexts.english: "I know. Saber had to help me because I went and got myself hurt. I don't have any excuses for that."

findings.description: The firearm analogy drops machine guns.
findings.sourceReading: Shirou distinguishes pistols, rifles, machine guns and shotguns as different mage performance types.
findings.explanation: The firearm analogy drops machine guns.

contexts.japanese: 銃の種類は短銃、ライフル銃、マシンガン、ショットガンと、魔術師ごとに性能が異なる。
contexts.english: Like how there are different guns—pistols, rifles, shotguns— mages all have a variety of abilities.

findings.description: Archer's expected half-capacity during recovery becomes only Rin remaining in the fight.
findings.sourceReading: Although full recovery will take time, Rin expects Archer can still perform at roughly half-fledged capacity.
findings.explanation: Archer's expected half-capacity during recovery becomes only Rin remaining in the fight.

contexts.japanese: 「そう。わたしのアーチャーは致命傷を受けて目下治療中。完全に回復するまで時間がかかるけど、それでも半人前ぐらいの活躍はできる筈よ。
contexts.english: "Yeah. My Archer's still recovering from a serious wound. That's going to take some time, but in the meantime, I'm not completely out of the fight.

findings.description: A reliable senior relationship becomes a bare judgment that Rin seems knowledgeable.
findings.sourceReading: For Shirou, who knows neither right nor left, Rin is a dependable senior he can rely on.
findings.explanation: A reliable senior relationship becomes a bare judgment that Rin seems knowledgeable.

contexts.japanese: 右も左も分からない俺にとって、遠坂は頼りになる先輩だ。
contexts.english: I know next to nothing, and Tohsaka does seem knowledgeable.

findings.description: Becoming a child of Shirou's household becomes merely living there.
findings.sourceReading: Sulking, Taiga says Illya might as well become a child of this household.
findings.explanation: Becoming a child of Shirou's household becomes merely living there.

contexts.japanese: 「……ふん。いっそのコトここの子になっちゃえ、ばか」
contexts.english: "Hmph. She might as well just live in this house, for all I care...dummy."

findings.description: The school's entrance ceremony becomes schools generally starting a new year.
findings.sourceReading: On April seventh, Shirou's school is holding its entrance ceremony as the season turns to spring.
findings.explanation: The school's entrance ceremony becomes schools generally starting a new year.

contexts.japanese: 学校では入学式があって、季節は寒い冬を越えて春になっている。
contexts.english: Schools are starting the new school year, and the season has gone from the cold of winter to spring.

findings.description: Rin's mock 'at last I have found you' aura disappears.
findings.sourceReading: Shirou jokes that Rin is radiating the hostile air of the idiom 'meeting here after a hundred years,' as if this were a long-awaited showdown.
findings.explanation: Rin's mock 'at last I have found you' aura disappears.

contexts.japanese: 朝っぱらから、ここで会ったが百年目、なんてオーラをちらつかせるのはよくないと思う。
contexts.english: I don't think getting angry so early in the morning is good for you.

findings.description: The imagined awakened demon's murder threat is removed.
findings.sourceReading: Shirou caricatures morning Rin as saying, roughly, 'I will kill whoever disturbs my sleep.'
findings.explanation: The imagined awakened demon's murder threat is removed.

contexts.japanese: こう、我が眠りヲ妨げる者ニぶっ殺す、みたいな。
contexts.english: Like, "Who dares disturb my slumber" kind of terrifying.

findings.description: Visible grief reassuring other people becomes grief being more normal.
findings.sourceReading: Rin says that in such a situation, the people around someone feel safer if that person becomes spectacularly depressed.
findings.explanation: Visible grief reassuring other people becomes grief being more normal.

contexts.japanese: 「だから、わたしはそれが心配だった。ああいう時はね、いっそ派手に落ち込んでくれた方が周りは安心するものなの」
contexts.english: "That's why I was worried that was going to happen. You know, there are times it's more normal to get spectacularly depressed."

findings.description: The king's public faces at court and on the battlefield become only a stern battlefield countenance.
findings.sourceReading: Bedivere wants a human smile unlike the face the king shows at the royal castle or on the battlefield.
findings.explanation: The king's public faces at court and on the battlefield become only a stern battlefield countenance.

contexts.japanese: 王城や戦場で見せる顔ではなく、素顔の、人間としての笑い顔が見たかった。
contexts.english: He wants so much to see his king's true face...not the stern countenance the king bore on the battlefield, but his king's true face...a smiling, laughing, human face.

findings.description: Bedivere's apology for his first and last injustice against the king disappears.
findings.sourceReading: He lies while inwardly apologizing that this is his first and last act of wrongdoing against his king.
findings.explanation: Bedivere's apology for his first and last injustice against the king disappears.

contexts.japanese: これが最初で最後の、王に対する不正と詫びて。
contexts.english: It is the first and last time he will do such a thing.

findings.description: The sword's three circuits through the sky are omitted.
findings.sourceReading: A white arm catches the sword, it circles the sky three times, and then the sacred sword vanishes from the world.
findings.explanation: The sword's three circuits through the sky are omitted.

contexts.japanese: 水面より現れた皓い腕が剣を受け止め、三度空を巡ったあと、聖剣はこの世界から消失した。
contexts.english: A white hand emerges from the water and catches the blade, and the sacred sword vanishes from the world.

findings.description: The only living person in the immediate area becomes simply the only one left alive.
findings.sourceReading: Within this surrounding area, Shirou perceives himself as the only person alive.
findings.explanation: The only living person in the immediate area becomes simply the only one left alive.

contexts.ref: セイバールート一日目-00:page2:1
contexts.japanese: この周辺で、生きているのは自分だけ。
contexts.english: I was the only one left alive.

findings.description: Ordinary waking light and unfamiliarity become light stabbing Shirou's eyes.
findings.sourceReading: He merely wakes to light entering his eyes but is unaccustomed to such a situation.
findings.explanation: Ordinary waking light and unfamiliarity become light stabbing Shirou's eyes.

contexts.ref: セイバールート一日目-00:page11:1
contexts.japanese: 目を覚まして光が目に入ってきただけだったが、そんな状況に慣れていなかった。
contexts.english: Light stabbed at my eyes when I woke.

findings.description: Sakura being energetic and happy becomes merely weirdly energetic.

findings.explanation: Sakura being energetic and happy becomes merely weirdly energetic.

contexts.ref: セイバールート一日目-00:page47:1
contexts.japanese: ……珍しい。本当に、今朝の桜は元気があって嬉しそうだ。
contexts.english: ...That's odd. Sakura is weirdly energetic this morning.

findings.explanation: Shirou's affectionate 'idiot' disappears.

contexts.ref: セイバールート一日目-00:page48:1
contexts.japanese: 「ばか、そういう訳にいくか。今起きるから、一緒にキッチンに行こう」
contexts.english: "No, no. I'm getting up, honest, so let's head to the kitchen together."

findings.description: Inheritance tax becomes inheritance in general.

findings.explanation: Inheritance tax becomes inheritance in general.

contexts.ref: セイバールート一日目-00:page65:1
contexts.japanese: 相続税とか資産税だとか、そういった難しい話は全て藤村の爺さんが受け持ってくれている。
contexts.english: So things like inheritance, property taxes, and any other complicated things are all handled by Old Man Fujimura.

findings.description: A capable junior and younger girl Shirou must look after becomes a considerate younger friend.

findings.explanation: A capable junior and younger girl Shirou must look after becomes a considerate younger friend.

contexts.english: Sakura's just a really good and considerate younger friend of mine, and she's someone I need to look after.

findings.description: The English preserves Rin standing there but drops her blank, distracted manner. The passage does not establish why she is in that state.

findings.explanation: The English preserves Rin standing there but drops her blank, distracted manner. The passage does not establish why she is in that state.

contexts.ref: セイバールート一日目-03:page33:1

contexts.english: I turn to face her, since she's been standing there the whole time.

findings.explanation: Shirou's explicit interest-versus-business correction disappears.

contexts.ref: セイバールート一日目-03:page42:1

findings.description: The class wanting to break its teacher-to-infirmary custom becomes generic reluctance.

findings.explanation: The class wanting to break its teacher-to-infirmary custom becomes generic reluctance.

contexts.english: Probably nobody's thrilled by the idea of taking a teacher to the infirmary.

findings.description: The victims' critical condition disappears from the report.

findings.explanation: The victims' critical condition disappears from the report.

contexts.english: It happened in a building in the business district. Apparently everyone on one of its floors lost consciousness from oxygen deprivation.

findings.description: Shirou's goal remains in English, but his insistence that he must not abandon it disappears.

findings.explanation: Shirou's goal remains in English, but his insistence that he must not abandon it disappears.

contexts.ref: セイバールート一日目-07:page28:1
contexts.japanese: そもそも、正義の味方になるって事は今でも破っちゃいけない目標だ。
contexts.english: Besides, becoming a hero of justice is still my goal.

findings.description: The English leaves the ongoing scope of Shirou's thanks implicit. It does not say he appreciates only this dinner.

findings.explanation: The English leaves the ongoing scope of Shirou's thanks implicit. It does not say he appreciates only this dinner.

contexts.japanese: 「晩飯、うまかったよ。いつもありがとうな」
contexts.english: "Dinner was good. Thank you."

findings.description: 'Gut feeling' preserves the premonition but loses the repeated insect wording connecting it to the chirping. This finding rests on the intact quoted lines, not the damaged continuation.

findings.explanation: 'Gut feeling' preserves the premonition but loses the repeated insect wording connecting it to the chirping. This finding rests on the intact quoted lines, not the damaged continuation.

contexts.english: The sound of a swing creaking.

contexts.japanese: それが虫の鳴き声だと気付くのに、わりと時間がかかったと思う。

contexts.japanese: 虫の報せ、というものがあるのなら。
contexts.english: If ever there was such a thing as a gut feeling...

findings.description: Training the one usable discipline disappears from Shirou's route to becoming like Kiritsugu.

findings.explanation: Training the one usable discipline disappears from Shirou's route to becoming like Kiritsugu.

contexts.english: What I do understand is that even someone like me can use at least one form of magecraft. If I can do that, then maybe I can be like Kiritsugu.

findings.explanation: Shirou's insistence that he must become a hero like Kiritsugu becomes a statement that he wants to.

contexts.english: "'Saving one person means not saving someone else. Being a hero of justice means you need to be an extremely egocentric person.' That was always his line."

contexts.japanese: その意味は知らない。
contexts.english: I still don't know what he meant by that.

contexts.english: All I'm certain of is that I want to save people—to be a hero of justice—like Kiritsugu Emiya.

findings.description: Doing everything possible toward an undefined ideal narrows into magical training.
findings.sourceReading: Because succession to Kiritsugu is fixed in his mind, Shirou has done whatever he can despite immaturity; since he does not know what a hero of justice is, he can now approach it only through acts useful to others within his reach.
findings.explanation: Doing everything possible toward an undefined ideal narrows into magical training.

contexts.ref: セイバールート一日目-15:page47:1
contexts.japanese: だから未熟なままでも、出来るかぎりの事をしてきた。
contexts.english: That's why I've been doing everything I can despite how sorely I lack in experience.

contexts.ref: セイバールート一日目-15:page47:1
contexts.japanese: 正義の味方っていうのが何者なのかは分からない。
contexts.english: I don't know exactly what it means to be a hero of justice.

contexts.ref: セイバールート一日目-15:page47:1
contexts.japanese: 分からないから、今はただ自分の出来る範囲で、誰かの為になる事でしか近づけない。
contexts.english: But because I don't know, I've trained myself to the best of my abilities in hopes I'll be useful to somebody.

findings.description: Shirou's conditional concession becomes mere repetition of Rin's request.

contexts.english: "Got it. I'll start making Western-style breakfasts from now on.

contexts.japanese: ……さっきおまえが言ってた、朝飯作るならパンにしろ、という提案も受け入れていい気になったり」
contexts.english: You said it earlier. You mentioned that breakfast should have bread."

findings.description: “Anyway” removes Shirou's reservation about Rin's teaching aptitude. Her enthusiasm consequently reads more like evidence that she will be a good teacher.

findings.explanation: “Anyway” removes Shirou's reservation about Rin's teaching aptitude. Her enthusiasm consequently reads more like evidence that she will be a good teacher.

contexts.english: Hm. Saber said she wasn't good at teaching, but I'm guessing this will be the total opposite.

contexts.ref: セイバールート七日目-01:page12:1
contexts.japanese: いや、向いてるか向いてないかは別にして。
contexts.english: Anyway...

findings.description: Personal mental force becomes unspecified personal means.

findings.explanation: Personal mental force becomes unspecified personal means.

contexts.english: Some may use magecraft via their own means, while some may do it by paying a price of some sort.

findings.description: Rin's old-mage impersonation disappears.

findings.explanation: Rin's old-mage impersonation disappears.

contexts.english: "And when a mage is on the brink of death, they pass down their great accomplishments to their successor in the form of a crest. It's their way of telling their successor to go further, to places they were unable to reach, and that their crest may be of some use to them.

findings.description: The deep history engraved in the crest disappears.
findings.sourceReading: Generational additions increase complexity and inscribe a deep history; that accumulated object is the Magic Crest and an inescapable bond.
findings.explanation: The deep history engraved in the crest disappears.

contexts.english: The Magic Crest gets more complex as it passes from generation to generation, but it's also a constraint mages can't escape."

findings.description: Breath hot enough to burn becomes disembodied heat.

findings.explanation: Breath hot enough to burn becomes disembodied heat.

findings.explanation: The life-or-death heat of combat becomes a bare proposition about mistakes.

findings.explanation: Archer’s third condition—preventing anyone else from being killed—disappears.
